style: Cinematic 3D-animated feature-film look, warm golden-hour firelight, rich amber and copper colour grade, shallow depth of field, same characters and art style as the reference image. Silent film: absolutely no music, no score, no singing, no soundtrack.

shots.prompt: Lil Blunt, a small green weed-nugget hero in a cowboy hat, rides the wooden mine cart down the tracks out of the mine mouth. The camera follows from behind. The tracks end at a dead end; the cart launches off the broken rails and flies in a slow arc over a wide gap into a sunlit woods plain with rocks and tree stumps. He tumbles, bonks his head hard on a tree stump and lies knocked out, little stars circling, dust settling.

Inside the gold-and-guns hideout, the huge black bull Inferno Bull, cigar in his mouth, kneels and gently dabs a cloth soaked in whiskey on the bump on the unconscious Lil Blunt's forehead. Lil Blunt winces and slowly stirs awake. Smoke drifts, molten gold glows behind.

Inferno Bull, seated, introduces himself with a confident gruff gesture, lifts the Winchester 1886 rifle and the glowing mining helmet and holds them out. Lil Blunt, grinning, hands over a small golden bitcoin coin in exchange, takes the helmet and puts it on, then grabs the rifle. Cigar smoke curls, lamplight flickers.

Inferno Bull stands behind Lil Blunt and shows him how to hold the Winchester, adjusting the aim toward a target in the hideout. Lil Blunt fires once, a bright muzzle flash, and the bull nods proudly and points toward the mine exit.
